evidence: The factual half holds: process_pull_request_event computes skip_reason = _review_skip_reason(pr) (products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:870), which returns 'untrusted_author_association' for NONE/FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR (tasks.py:218-234, PAYLOAD_GATE_AUTHOR_ASSOCIATIONS at :98), and the carve-out's provenance overrides ANY skip_reason (tasks.py:880-881: only `skip_reason is not None and inbox_review is None` skips), so an association-NONE bot PR does re-review; AGENTS.md:110-112 names only the review-mode and author-write-permission gates as bypassed. But the doc is not the contract and the omission is not a hidden bypass: AGENTS.md:82-84 already states the exception applies to 'the webhook pre-filter (`_review_skip_reason`)' as a whole, which by name includes its association branch; the carve-out's own docstring enumerates the bypassed set explicitly - 'bot author, draft, author association, write permission, review mode' (tasks.py:144-153); the call-site comment says the PR 're-reviews despite tripping every filter here' (tasks.py:865-868); and the behaviour is pinned by test_inbox_carve_out_rereviews_a_selfdriving_pr_past_every_gate (products/stamphog/backend/tests/test_tasks.py:762-793), whose fixture hard-codes `author_association: 'NONE'` (test_tasks.py:748) and asserts a QUEUED run with inbox provenance. Security-wise the association pre-filter is documented as 'necessary but not sufficient' and the authoritative gate is _author_lacks_write_permission (tasks.py:80-98, :94), which AGENTS.md:110 DOES list as bypassed with the same rationale (task linkage + toggle replace author trust, tasks.py:960-969); naming the weaker pre-check adds no new trust decision. No production call path behaves differently because of the missing words; this is a doc-completeness nit on a section that already names the bypassed function, matching the KB5 precedent (doc restatement, not real).
notes: I would flip to real (consider) if AGENTS.md were the only place the bypassed set was written down (the tasks.py:150-152 docstring did not exist), or if the doc affirmatively claimed the association pre-filter still applied to carved-out PRs; and to should_fix if a code path enforced the association check by consulting the doc's list (there is none - the override is unconditional at tasks.py:880-881 and test-pinned).
